posts.title: When Navigation Speaks to its Environment: How AR Can Change the Way We Move Through Cities
posts.summary: The ARiadne project develops AR pedestrian navigation with HSHL and SWCode — and drew a visit from NRW Minister of Economics Mona Neubaur in April 2026.

posts.title: CHI 2026: XR Research from the Immersive Reality Lab
posts.summary: Three lab contributions at CHI 2026 in Barcelona — on XR under stress, adaptive resilience in fast-jet training, and cross-cultural user experience in VR.

posts.title: MMVE 2026: How Immersive Media Systems Bring XR Research Together
posts.summary: A workshop at the intersection of immersive technology, experience design, perception research and systems development — and the question of who gets left behind as XR spreads.

posts.title: Looking Ahead: How Intelligent AR Navigation Could Transform Cities
posts.summary: How does urban space change when digital information no longer has to be searched for on a map, but instead appears directly in the field of view?

posts.title: Why Human-Centered XR Metrics Matter
posts.summary: Frame rate, latency and tracking precision are essential — but they cannot tell you whether an XR experience is usable, engaging and safe for real people.
